description: This file contains classes and functions related to computing differences between HTML documents, including DOM tree construction, text node handling, and output generation for HTML diffs.

classes.name: LastCommonParentResult
classes.description: Represents the last common parent of two nodes in the DOM tree, including depth and index information.

classes.name: Modification
classes.description: Represents a change (addition, removal, modification) in the diff process, with type and ID information.

classes.name: DomTreeBuilder
classes.description: Builds a DOM tree from HTML input, managing elements, text nodes, and structural relationships.

classes.name: TextNodeDiffer
classes.description: Handles comparison and modification marking of text nodes between old and new DOM trees.

classes.name: HTMLDiffer
classes.description: Main class orchestrating the HTML diff process, including parsing, diffing, and output generation.

classes.name: TextOnlyComparator
classes.description: Compares sequences of text nodes, used for calculating similarity ratios.

classes.name: AncestorComparator
classes.description: Compares the ancestry of nodes to detect changes in the DOM hierarchy.

classes.name: ChangeTextGenerator
classes.description: Generates human-readable descriptions of changes between node hierarchies.

classes.name: ChangeText
classes.description: Builds string representations of change descriptions for HTML diff output.

classes.name: TagToStringFactory
classes.description: Factory for creating tag-to-string representations based on tag type and change semantics.

classes.name: TagToString
classes.description: Generates descriptive text for added, removed, or changed tags.

classes.name: NoContentTagToString
classes.description:
Specialized for tags without inner content, such as `
`, ``, indicating modification.

classes.name: AnchorToString
classes.description: Handles description generation for `<a>` tags with destination attributes.

classes.name: HTMLOutput
classes.description: Creates HTML-formatted diff output, wrapping changed parts with styled spans.

classes.name: ContentHandler
classes.description: Helper class for building HTML output, managing tags and text content.

methods.name: htmlDiff
methods.description: Performs a diff between two HTML strings, returning HTML formatted diff and the number of differences.
